data.summary: The launch date is not published.
The trip is not worked out until a launch time is set.
The landing date is known only as 'late 2028', so there is no single window: compare months on the calendar instead.
No landing spot is published, so contact cannot be worked out.
The launch vehicle is not published; nothing returns from the Moon.

parts.note: Each line counts or names what the section shows; it is never a verdict on the mission.
